g.title: MesotheliomaQSP
g.text: Malignant Pleural Mesothelioma — QSP mechanistic map

tumour as a rind whose only degree of freedom is thickness ·one collagen state with three consequences ·two delivery routes with opposite gradients ·histology as a continuous axis that flips the sign of the comparison

g.title: SMRPVOL
g.text: SMRP is a SHED SURFACE product:

g.title: CLAIM1
g.text: A rind has dV/dh = A, a constant.
mRECIST's 30% thickness threshold is a 30% VOLUME kill;
RECIST's 30% diameter threshold on a sphere is a 66% volume kill.
The same words 'partial response' denote a 2.2-fold different cytoreduction.

g.title: CLAIM2
g.text: CLAIM 2 - ONE COLLAGEN STATE, THREE CONSEQUENCES
phi biases the measurement (it does not shrink),
phi shortens the penetration length (it collapses vessels),
phi traps the lung (it stiffens the visceral leaf).
A drug that killed every tumour cell would still leave
a thick rind, a low FVC and a failed pleurodesis.

g.title: CLAIM3
g.text: CLAIM 3 - THE HISTOLOGY AXIS FLIPS THE SIGN
x raises proliferation, chemoresistance, collagen AND PD-L1.
The first three hurt chemotherapy, the fourth helps IO.
The crossover between the two regimens is therefore a
COMPUTED consequence of one parameter, not two disease models.
